Her debut EP "Can't Blame a Girl for Trying" was released in 2014, and she has since released two full-length albums: "Eyes Wide Open" (2015) and "Evolution" (2016).

It lay dormant until 1970, when Carpenter and his sister, Karen Carpenter, appeared on a syndicated radio show, called "Your Navy Presents". Carpenter did not think of recording a studio version of the song for record release until 1972 with the release of the album, "A Song for You".  This cut is much faster than the "Your Navy Presents" version, and features the piano rather than the oboe.
